parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the ENS edge zone.

parameters.name: EnsRegionIds
parameters.description: The array of ENS edge zone IDs. Array length: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: Isp
parameters.description:
The Internet service provider (ISP). Valid values:
- cmcc: China Mobile.
- unicom: China Unicom.
- telecom: China Telecom.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging queries. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: SecondaryPublicIpId
parameters.description: The ID of the secondary public IP address.
